correctness.rationale: Independently rebuilt the labelled 24 triangles on nine vertices, 36 complete-skeleton edges, mod-two triangle boundary rank 23 and H1_F2 dimension 36-8-23=5. Exhaustive simple-cycle enumeration at lengths 3,4,5,6 gives class spectrum 24,3,3,1 and shortest-class multiplicities 3,9,9,3 at length 3, then 6,18,66 for lengths 4,5,6. Exhaustive 9! facet-preserving vertex permutations yield group order 18 and seven class orbits of sizes 1,3,3,3,3,9,9. The increasingly oriented facet sum has even integral boundary coefficients -2(6), 0(12), 2(18); half-boundary is a cycle of nonzero mod-two class and order dividing two in integral H1. Given the published H1_Z=Z^4⊕Z/2 for this genus-five nonorientable closed surface, it is the unique torsion element; its mod-two reduction is the only minimum-length-six class, with 66 representatives. Exhaustiveness applies only to the 31 classes in this exact complex, all reached by six edges.

value.rationale: The surface is the canonical minimal neighborly vertex-transitive triangulation of a genus-five nonorientable surface. The shortest simple cycle representatives for every one of its 31 mod-two H1 classes are a natural discrete homological length invariant, with unusual unique six-edge torsion orientation class and exact symmetry orbit/multiplicities. These are not determined by a pre-existing homology table and could be used to study minimal representatives and isometry/symmetry in finite triangulations; this complete classification is mathematically motivated and nontrivial beyond code output.

scientific_limitations: Claim confined to the exact nine-vertex labelled triangulation and mod-two nonzero homology classes; no assertions about the other nine-vertex N5 surface or cycles >6 necessary.
